surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions for the (CpCH3)3Gd/H2O process involved partial decomposition of the metal precursor, which affected the film growth mechanism. The growth rate increased with precursor pulse length, indicating decomposition. The self-limiting nature was not observed, unlike the Gd(thd)3/O3 process. The decomposition of (CpCH3)3Gd did not generate impurities, and stoichiometric films with low levels of C and H were obtained at 250°C.
